title: Membership & Subscription MRR and Churn Forecaster

listing.description_html:
Project members, monthly recurring revenue and net revenue after fees for 24 months from your price, sign-ups, growth and churn, with the steady-state member count and customer lifetime value.

This forecaster takes your starting members, price, monthly sign-ups, sign-up growth, churn and payment fees, and builds a 24-month projection of members, MRR, net revenue and cumulative revenue. It also shows the member count the business settles at if sign-ups stay flat (sign-ups divided by churn), the average member lifetime, and lifetime value per member.

What's included

  • 24-month projection of members, MRR, net revenue and cumulative revenue
  • Sign-up growth and monthly churn as separate inputs
  • Steady-state member count: where joins equal cancellations
  • Average member lifetime and lifetime value after fees
  • Month 12 and month 24 members, MRR and ARR on one summary
  • PDF guide with the formulas, a worked example and churn-measurement tips

Who it's for

  • Paid community and membership site owners
  • Newsletter and Patreon-style creators
  • Small SaaS and subscription box founders
  • Coaches selling monthly programs

You get: membership_subscription_mrr_churn_forecaster.xlsx (Settings, Forecast, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a forecasting tool, not financial, tax or investment advice. It projects from the assumptions you enter; real sign-ups and churn will differ month to month.
